rows.jyutping: mei6 liu5 gaai2 zau6 haa6 ding6 leon6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone forms an opinion before knowing the facts.

example.english: We shouldn't prejudge the situation before understanding it.
example.traditional: 我哋未了解就下定論，未必公平。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mei6 liu5 gaai2 zau6 haa6 ding6 leon6 mei6 bit1 gung1 ping4

rows.note: Use this when the advance judgment comes from a preconceived idea or first impression.

example.english: Don't prejudge them; hear both sides first.
example.traditional: 你唔好先入為主，聽晒雙方講法先。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2 teng1 saai3 soeng1 fong1 gong2 faat3 sin1

rows.note: Use this more formal wording when explicitly describing judgment made in advance rather than criticizing a biased attitude.

example.english: We should not prejudge the outcome before there is sufficient evidence.
example.traditional: 喺未有足夠證據之前，唔應該預先判斷結果。
example.jyutping: hai2 mei6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 zing3 geoi3 zi1 cin4 m4 jing1 goi1 jyu6 sin1 pun3 dyun6 git3 gwo2
